A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DoVer study, with complete, readable main texts and Appendices A–D. Textual and visual inspection supports reliable comparison of the methods, equations, figures, tables, and results despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original debugging experiments, attribution analyses, ablations, and case studies in Sections 3 and 5, with additional experimental results and annotations in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including intervention success rates, hypothesis-validation outcomes, model and prompting ablations, and the Appendix A attribution experiments.

M1.justification: The four-stage DoVer pipeline, orchestrator message and plan interventions, and checkpoint-based replay procedure are unchanged. The corresponding prompts and framework integration in Appendices B and C also remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same Who&When attribution evaluations and debugging coverage spanning AssistantBench, GAIA, and GSMPlus. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Section 5.3 retains the same Self-Refine-style and CRITIC-style comparisons. The Random, WW baseline, reproduced baseline, and prompt-refinement rows in Appendix A's Table 5 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Table 1 retain the same splits, sample counts, agent frameworks, and model configurations. Section 4.2's success and progress metrics and hypothesis-classification rules are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same model and few-shot ablations, annotation-uncertainty analyses, qualitative case studies, and targeted WebSurfer enhancement experiment. The supporting analyses in Appendices A and D are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both specify three runs per intervention and three repetitions of the Appendix A attribution experiments. Table 5 retains identical plus/minus reporting, and Table 7 retains the same individual-run outputs; no statistical reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: Table 2 retains trial success rates of 17.6% for both WW-AB and WW-GAIA, 27.5% for GAIA-Level-1, and 49.0% for GSMPlus. Progress scores, ablation results, baseline outcomes, appendix results, and qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The trace and hypothesis definitions, milestone-achievement formula, and normalized progress definition in Section 4 are unchanged. Neither version adds different assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: intervention-driven debugging, analysis of ambiguous failure attribution, and empirical recovery and hypothesis validation. Their scientific scope and claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of annotation ambiguity, inconclusive interventions, and sub-agent capability bottlenecks are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning evaluated systems, replay requirements, restricted interventions, and LLM-based judging.

D1.justification: Model-version and API settings, Appendix B prompts, Appendix C checkpointing and integration details, and project/code-access statements are unchanged. No additional reproducibility details or resource-availability changes are reported.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to attribution and debugging approaches are unchanged. The bibliography reflows after the added acknowledgements but retains the same references.

P1.justification: v3 expands the institutional affiliations and adds an Acknowledgements section before the references. The scientific prose and research-section organization remain unchanged, making this a limited editorial addition.

P2.justification: The affiliation and acknowledgement additions cause text and reference reflow. Table 5 moves from page 14 to page 15 with unchanged contents, caption, and design; the other figures and tables retain their substantive displays.

improvement.justification: v3 adds acknowledgements and fuller affiliation information, with accompanying pagination changes. The method, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
